title: Spicy Korean-Style Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir-fry made with Japanese-style noodles and Korean-inspired flavors.
instructions: Cook the Japanese-style noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the yellow onion and sliced yellow bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Spicy Korean chili flakes and Korean chili paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the spicy sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Stir in the soy sauce and chopped green onions.
Serve the noodle stir-fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Optional: Add sliced yellow onions or green onions on top of the noodles for added flavor and texture.
